patch_description: This approach uses a physics-based "Active Contours" (Snakes) algorithm. Instead of a straight line or simple geometric heuristic, it models the drone path as a flexible string. We define an energy function with three components: internal smoothness (to minimize flying distance), repulsion from the school (to minimize noise), and attraction to the base station (to minimize signal drop). By applying gradient descent, the path iteratively deforms to find the optimal balance between these three competing objectives, naturally bending away from the school and towards the base station.
